doc: Per-SM tensor pipe occupancy of one warpgroup-/CTA-level MMA op (wgmma on Hopper, tcgen05.mma on Blackwell): the op starts when the SM's tensor pipe frontier allows and holds it for `cycles`; the arch module adds group / commit semantics. Measurement scope (both devices): the pipe beat and completion are measured with accumulating same-D operations (wgmma / tcgen05.mma chains that accumulate into one D); input-D-disabled and independently pipelined D variants are not measured separately and are modelled with the same values (formerly the b300 source experimental.umma.accumulating_scope). operand_read_bytes_per_cycle: shared-memory operand bytes per cycle that an MMA reads through the per-SM operand path it shares with tcgen05.cp; absent means the op holds that path for its whole beat
